tournament.name: Bcdl 19 - Ohio - Buffalo Chicken Dip Legacy

decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This allows the player to cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Daze, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is built to support the deck's dual-color requirements and includes fetchlands for consistency.

The deck focuses on generating a large storm count to cast Tendrils of Agony or other key spells for massive damage. It includes various ways to draw cards, generate mana, and replay spells from the graveyard. Key cards like Brainstorm and Burning Wish help find necessary pieces to build up the storm count quickly. Additionally, the deck utilizes a mix of land types for flexibility in mana production and fetching key cards. Strong protection is provided with spells like Veil of Summer to ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Go for the Throat. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Baleful Strix to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with creatures like Barrowgoyf and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath, while using countermagic like Force of Will to protect its key cards. The mana base is optimized for consistency and efficiency with fetch lands and dual lands.

The deck focuses on using the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the deck, then use Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for a win condition. The deck also utilizes protection with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga helps to find combo pieces, while Narcomoeba provides additional value. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game before the opponent can disrupt the plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful spells and creatures to quickly mill through the deck and set up a win condition. By combining cards that can generate mana quickly like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual with cards that can mill like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, the deck aims to fill the graveyard with crucial combo pieces. Once enough cards are in the graveyard, the player can win the game using Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation to protect its combo.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize various control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card draw to stifle the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing the powerful combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to efficiently close out games. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Curie, Emergent Intelligence help to further disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card advantage. The mana base is streamlined with fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors for spells and abilities.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive cards like Daze and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck uses powerful threats like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty to close out the game quickly, while also providing utility with cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. It aims to win the game through a powerful combo of reanimation and aggressive threats.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm. It then utilizes Reanimate to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a big advantage. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Daze for protection and disruption, as well as Thoughtseize for hand disruption. The mana base includes dual lands like Underground Sea and Wasteland to ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces for a powerful reanimation strategy.

This BUG Control deck focuses on utilizing a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and hand disruption to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also presenting threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to close out the game. With a mix of powerful removal, card draw, and disruption, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and grind out victories through incremental advantage.

The key strategy of this Aggro - Canadian Threshold deck is to quickly deploy threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Delver of Secrets, and Murktide Regent to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. Using a mana base of dual lands and fetch lands, the deck aims to be proactive and efficient in executing its game plan.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying aggressive threats of its own. By utilizing a combination of disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, the deck can slow down the opponent's game plan. Meanwhile, it can quickly close out the game with efficient beaters like Solitude and Skyclave Apparition. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for flexibility in deploying creatures at instant speed, while also providing card advantage through Recruiter of the Guard.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive Eldrazi creatures quickly, utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt opponents' spells, while Thought-Knot Seer provides both disruption and card advantage. The deck also contains a mix of utility lands like Maze of Ith and Wasteland to control the board. The key strategy is to play powerful Eldrazi creatures ahead of curve and disrupt opponents' game plan with disruptive spells and lands.

The deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption while gaining card advantage through card draw and recursion. It also has a mix of threats that can provide pressure and help close out the game. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency. Emphasis is placed on controlling the pace of the game and out-valuing the opponent through efficient plays and powerful synergies.

The focus of this Mardu Aggro deck is to aggressively pressure the opponent with a mix of creatures and disruption spells. By combining efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Amped Raptor with powerful disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy, the deck aims to control the game while also dealing quick damage. Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach and removal, while Static Prison helps to lock down the opponent's board. With a mix of aggressive creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

Ramp into big creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Nadu, Winged Wisdom while using combo pieces like Nomads en-Kor and Springheart Nantuko for protection and synergy. Use Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor up key pieces quickly. Utilize Gaea's Cradle for mana acceleration and take advantage of the mix of creatures and spells to create explosive turns and overwhelm opponents. Control the board with cards like Sylvan Safekeeper and Collector Ouphe to protect your combo and secure the win.

The deck revolves around using the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill your opponent's library. It includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor for key pieces, as well as disruption spells like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect your combo. The deck also includes mana acceleration like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly assemble the combo. Overall, the key strategy is to quickly set up the Painter's Servant/Grindstone combo while utilizing various cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan.
